visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown tabby cat with large, dark eyes peeks over a purple, upholstered surface. In the foreground, a thick braided rope toy with yellow, light blue, and lavender strands hangs vertically. The background is a neutral-toned wall with a light wood-grain texture. (2) The cat lunges forward, grabbing the colorful braided rope with its mouth and right paw. Its pupils are dilated, showing high excitement. The camera follows the quick movement as the cat engages with the toy. (3) The cat retreats behind the purple surface, hiding its body while its head remains visible, tracking the movement of the rope toy. The rope is slightly blurred in the foreground, suggesting it is being moved by someone off-camera. (4) The cat pounces again, biting the rope firmly near the top. It uses its paws to bat at the rope, showing playful hunting behavior. The soft, warm indoor lighting emphasizes the texture of the cat's fur and the braided toy. (5) The cat maintains its grip on the rope with its mouth, looking directly into the camera lens with a curious and intense gaze. Its ears are tilted forward, and its whiskers are prominent against the purple edge. (6) The cat leans in very close to the camera, its face nearly filling the frame as it investigates the lens. It then retreats back to its hiding spot behind the purple barrier, still focused on the rope.
